t.p: Welcome to Liaise International, where we embody the true spirit of Australia. Born from the creativity and innovation of genuine Aussies, we proudly present the iconic Rocko's line alongside a suite of other brands that have seamlessly integrated into the fabric of Australian culture. As quintessentially Australian as a barbie on Bondi Beach, our products are crafted with authenticity, durability, and a touch of local charm.

Liaise International began with a simple yet powerful vision: to create products that resonate with the heart and soul of Australia. From the bustling city streets to the sun-kissed shores, we aimed to deliver items that cater to every Australian's lifestyle. Our journey started with Rocko's, a brand designed to withstand the rigors of both a tradie's demanding day and a lazy afternoon at the beach.
t.h2: Rocko's: The Epitome of Aussie Resilience
t.p: At the core of our brand lineup is Rocko's, the holy grail for your typical Aussie bloke or sheila. Our products are crafted tough as nails, designed to endure everything from the harsh conditions of a tradie's toolbox to the relaxing vibes of a coastal retreat. With Rocko's, you're investing in gear that'll outlast even the most relentless Aussie sun, ensuring durability and reliability with every use.

Our claim to fame? The legendary Aussie Double Plugger! These thongs are thicker than a snide remark from a local larrikin and double-plugged at every turn, making them the top choice for tradies and thong aficionados across the land. Whether you're navigating rocky terrain or enjoying a casual stroll, these thongs provide unmatched comfort and resilience.
t.h2: More Than Just Thongs: Our Diverse Range
t.p: But wait, there's more! At Liaise International, we believe in offering a comprehensive range of products to suit every budget and style. From sunnies and thongs to hats and caps, we've got it all. Our mission is to provide top-notch, fair dinkum perfection in every item we produce. Our brands are designed to capture the essence of the Aussie lifestyle, ensuring that you can find something to love in our diverse collection.

Our sunnies are perfect for shielding your eyes from the intense Australian sun, while our hats and caps offer both style and functionality. Whether you're hitting the beach, exploring the outback, or simply enjoying a day out, our accessories are designed to keep you comfortable and looking sharp.
Liaise International isn't just about Rocko's. We house a variety of other ripper brands, each with its unique flair and dedication to quality.

Mangrove Jacks brings you a selection of products that are as versatile and reliable as the Aussie spirit. From outdoor gear to fishing essentials, this brand is all about enhancing your outdoor experience.

For those who appreciate innovation and technology, Smartcell offers cutting-edge products designed to integrate seamlessly into your life. Our tech accessories are crafted to keep you connected and efficient, whether you're at work or play.

We're passionate about spreading the Aussie spirit far and wide. If you're interested in learning more about Rocko's, Liaise International, Mangrove Jacks, Smartcell, or any of our other fantastic brands, give us a bell today! We're always eager to share the story behind our products and how they can enrich your lifestyle.

And hey, if you reckon your shop could use a dash of Aussie flair, why not jump on board and start stocking Rocko's? It's the quickest way to earn your stripes as a fair dinkum Aussie business. By becoming a stockist, you're not just selling products; you're offering a piece of Australia to your customers. Together, we can create a network of retailers who celebrate the unique charm and durability of our brands.

t.h2: Our Commitment to Quality and Sustainability
t.p: At Liaise International, we're committed to more than just creating great products. We're dedicated to ensuring that our operations are sustainable and environmentally friendly. We believe in taking care of our beautiful country and are constantly seeking ways to reduce our environmental footprint.

From sourcing materials responsibly to implementing eco-friendly manufacturing processes, we're doing our part to protect the environment. Our commitment to sustainability extends to our packaging, ensuring that we use recyclable materials whenever possible.

We believe in giving back to the communities that support us. Liaise International is proud to engage in initiatives that support local businesses, charities, and community projects. By investing in our communities, we're helping to build a brighter future for all Australians.

As we look to the future, Liaise International remains dedicated to innovation, quality, and the Australian spirit. We're excited to continue expanding our product lines, exploring new technologies, and finding even more ways to bring a touch of Aussie magic to the world. Thank you for being a part of our journey. Together, let's celebrate the essence of Australia with every product we create.

Stay connected with us through our social media channels and newsletter. Be the first to know about new product launches, special offers, and the latest news from Liaise International. Join our community of loyal customers who appreciate the value of authentic, high-quality Aussie products.

If you’re looking to return or exchange your order, we’re here to help! We offer returns within 30 days of purchase. Please note that you will be responsible for the cost of return shipping. You can return your product for a credit, exchange or refund to the original payment method.
Before proceeding, please contact our Customer Care team to obtain a Return Authorisation (RA) number. This step is required for all returns and exchanges.

ul.li: Customer Account: Log in to your account for support and to request a return.
Contact Us Form: Submit any queries through our online form.
Returns must be made within 30 days of the purchase date.
Items must be in their original, unused condition, with swing tags and original packaging intact.

Returned items must have no visible signs of wear or use. Any returned items that do not meet these conditions may be sent back to the customer at their expense, and no refund, exchange, or credit will be provided.

t.h2: To initiate a return, please complete the following steps

ol.li: Reply to your order confirmation email to request which product/s you would like to return or email us at support@rockos.com.au.
Print the return shipping label created in the Australia Post return portal.

Send all items back to us using the label provided. (Please note, if you choose to send your item back using a different method and your parcel is lost in transit, we are unable to assist with a lost parcel claim)

t.p: If your order arrives damaged, please email us at support@rockos.com.au as soon as possible with your order number and a photo of the item’s condition. We address these situations on a case-by-case basis but will do our best to work towards a satisfactory solution. Once approved, we will cover the cost of return shipping for damaged or faulty products.
Upon receipt of your return, we will inspect the item to ensure it meets our return conditions.
Approved refunds will be processed to the original payment method within 2 business days. Please note that any original shipping fees are non-refundable.
Exchanges and stores credits will be processed within 2 business days.
If you have any questions or require further assistance, our Customer Care team is here to help and ensure you have a positive shopping experience with us.
At Liaise International, we strive to deliver your orders efficiently and promptly. Please note that we only deliver within Australia.

Orders are processed within 1 to 3 business days (excluding weekends and holidays) after your order confirmation email is sent. Please note that payment must be received before we can dispatch your order.

Once your order has shipped, you will receive an email notification with tracking details. For tracking information, please log in to your Customer Account or check your email for the shipping confirmation.
Most orders are shipped via Australia Post Standard Delivery. Parcels are left in a safe place at the delivery address unless you request a signature on delivery in your order notes at checkout.

ul.li: Free Shipping: Retail (non-wholesale) orders over $50 qualify for free shipping.
Flat Rate: Retail (non-wholesale) orders under $50 are charged a flat rate of $12.50.
Express Post: Available at checkout for a flat $15.
Same-Day Dispatch: Orders received before 10am, Monday through Friday are typically dispatched the same day.
Next Business Day Dispatch: Orders placed after 10am, Monday through Friday or on weekends or public holidays will be shipped the following business day, provided payment has been received.

t.p: Please note that the delivery times below are estimates provided by Australia Post. Once your order is in their hands, delivery timeframes are subject to their processes, and occasional unforeseen delays may occur.

ul.li: Standard Delivery: Expected delivery time is within 1–5 business days.
Non-Shipping Days: We do not ship on Saturdays, Sundays, or public holidays.
Rural Areas: Deliveries to Australian rural areas may take slightly longer.

t.h2: How do I check the status of my order?
t.p: Once your order has shipped, you will receive an email notification that includes a tracking number. Please allow up to 48 hours for tracking information to become available on the courier’s website.

If your order hasn’t arrived within 14 business days of receiving your shipping confirmation email, please contact us at support@rockos.com.au with your name and order number, and we will look into it for you.
We are pleased to ship to P.O. Boxes and Parcel Lockers within Australia.

A cookie is a small file placed on your computer's hard drive with your permission. Cookies help analyse web traffic or inform you when you visit a specific site, enabling web applications to respond to you as an individual by tailoring operations to your needs, likes, and dislikes.

ul.li: Traffic Log Cookies: Used to identify which pages are being used, helping us analyse webpage traffic and improve our website to meet customer needs. This information is used for statistical analysis only and is then removed from the system.

Managing Cookies: You can accept or decline cookies. Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can modify your browser settings to decline cookies if you prefer. This may limit your use of the website.

t.p: Your trust is important to us, and we take every precaution to protect your personal information. If you have any questions about our security practices, please contact our customer service team.

t.h3: Liaise International (Rockos) Proudly Supports the Australian Melanoma Research Foundation!
t.p: Liaise International (Rockos) is thrilled to partner with the Australian Melanoma Research Foundation (AMRF) to raise awareness and essential funds for melanoma research.

Melanoma is the third most common cancer in both Australian women and men and the most common cancer in Australians aged 15-44 years. In 2011 alone, 11,570 people in Australia were diagnosed with melanoma.

To support this vital cause, Liaise International (Rockos) is offering a special range of AMRF-endorsed products, including Rockos, Mangrove Jacks, MJ Kids, and Stiletto polarised sunglasses. A percentage of sales from these items will be directed to the AMRF.
Show your support by purchasing AMRF-endorsed sunglasses from any of Liaise International’s stockists, which include selected:

ul.li: IGA stores
Fishing & Boating stores
Newsagents
Service Stations
General Stores
Road Houses
Pharmacies

t.h3: Together, We Can Make a Difference!
t.p: By choosing AMRF sunglasses, you're not only protecting your eyes with quality eyewear but also contributing to a critical cause. Thank you for helping us support the Australian Melanoma Research Foundation!
